i've been playing around with this for the past hour

you can now ask codex to rename your threads based on the latest work you did in them, or create an automation that renames them any way you want every x minutes/hours

so nice, i don't have to manually rename anything anymore, which i was doing nonstop

you can also ask codex to pin and unpin the most active threads for you

tomorrow i will ask codex to look through all of my threads, archive/delete the stale ones, and find the areas where i get the most resistance

good night 💤
